tasks.short: Maintain investigation reports and verified arson records.

steps.what: Capture and verify actual investigation findings, evidence references and authorised suspect/conviction status records
inputs: actual investigation findings and evidence records
actual authorised case/person status records
outputs: checked actual investigation and person-record source fields

steps.what: Transfer exact existing incident and person identifiers into investigation record drafts in case software {OTHER}
inputs: checked actual investigation and person-record source fields
actual supported incident/case/person field mappings
outputs: imported actual case metadata and verified status-field drafts

steps.what: Prepare and maintain reports of investigation results from actual investigator findings
inputs: checked actual investigation and person-record source fields
imported actual case metadata and verified status-field drafts
outputs: complete actual investigation report and person-record draft

loop.purpose: Draft investigation narrative from actual findings
loop.input: Actual investigator findings, exact source references and verified case metadata
loop.check: Investigator checks observation versus inference, omitted uncertainty, source fidelity and unsupported cause/person allegations
loop.stop: Missing actual finding or two failed revisions returns narrative to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native case fields and fixed report headings first; investigation explanations vary

steps.what: Check final report and convicted arsonist/suspect records against authoritative sources and actual record authority
inputs: complete actual investigation report and person-record draft
checked actual investigation and person-record source fields
outputs: checked final report and exact authorised person/status updates

steps.what: Commit the exact checked final investigation report
inputs: checked final report and exact authorised person/status updates

steps.what: Commit exact checked authorised convicted-arsonist or arson-suspect record updates
inputs: checked final report and exact authorised person/status updates
outputs: committed actual verified person/status record updates

tasks.design: Configure native exact-field transfer into investigation case software {OTHER}, with originals linked in {DOCS}. Bound report narrative drafting to actual investigator findings; retain full report/person-status checking and separate final report and person-record commits.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reporting can repeat metadata transfer and narrative writing after findings exist.
tasks.enabler_now: Supported field transfer and bounded source-linked drafting can reduce preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Evidence meaning and authoritative person status require complete source verification.
tasks.human_edge: The investigator distinguishes an allegation, a finding and an actual conviction record.
tasks.altitude: Less report production; evidential and person-status judgement stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: supported case-field transfer and bounded narrative drafting can support investigation records; they do not establish fire cause or a person's suspect/conviction status.

assumptions: Actual investigation/incident owner supplies case ID, date/location and evidence references; authorised person-record owner supplies exact identity, status, source/version and permitted update. Investigator verifies actual findings/status and primary capture in s1; missing authority/status stays manual, never inferred.

S2 transfers existing exact fields only. Retained s3 captures/corrects actual narrative meaning and any new record fields. Full evidence/status/disclosure checks remain in s4; no automatic person classification.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native imports/fields first; existing case integration earns zero saving. Report and person updates are alternative actual record duties requiring reweighting where absent.

Each commit retains one percent using existing final check after exact content exists. If a separate actual authorised person-record owner must approve, exact final update goes to that owner before commit; no new write authority or avoided approval labour assumed. External report delivery is a separate actual gated send.
unknowns: Which incident/person metadata is entered twice?
research_questions: Can supported transfer and drafting reduce preparation after complete evidence/status checking?

already_counted.description: Capture and correct actual investigation meaning within s3.

incremental.description: Maintain actual case/person source mappings and narrative checks.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final actual investigation report and exact case destination; edits require recheck
s4 checked exact final person identity/status updates, authoritative source and permitted record destination; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20 duplicate transfer + 20*0.30 narrative = 26; minus 1.5 upkeep = 24.5. Half eligible gives 13 minus 1.5 = 11.5. Primary capture, full source/status checks and commits retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Testify in fire, arson and false-alarm cases.

steps.what: Retrieve and verify actual case evidence, investigation records and testimony source references
inputs: actual court case and testimony scope
actual investigation records and original evidence references

steps.what: Testify in actual court cases involving fires, suspected arson and false alarms
inputs: checked actual testimony source set
actual court questions and personal investigation knowledge
outputs: actual testimony and answers in court

tasks.design: Configure native case/evidence links in investigation software {OTHER} and {DOCS}. The investigator checks actual originals and retains preparation of truthful answers, all testimony and court interaction.
tasks.previous_blocker: Testimony preparation can repeat evidence navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case/evidence links can reduce retrieval.
tasks.still_hard: Truthful testimony depends on personal knowledge, evidence and actual questions.
tasks.human_edge: The investigator distinguishes what was observed from what remains uncertain.
tasks.altitude: Less evidence retrieval; court testimony stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native case/evidence links can support testimony preparation; they cannot provide personal knowledge or testify in court.

assumptions: Actual case/evidence owners supply original records, checked in s1. Original review and preparation of accurate answers remain retained; only navigation loses time.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native links first; existing linked access earns zero saving. No written statement/report/send is specified by actual oral testimony; investigation reports are explicit under 22991, counted once. Any separate actual statement submission requires its own final-version-gated send.
research_questions: Can native links reduce retrieval while preserving full original-evidence review?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.40 evidence navigation = 8; minus 0.5 upkeep = 7.5. Half eligible gives 4 minus 0.5 = 3.5. Original review and testimony retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Inspect actual collected evidence and choose suitable protective containers and separation
inputs: actual collected evidence and collector identity/item references
actual preservation and packaging requirements
outputs: actual inspected evidence and chosen packaging

steps.what: Prepare and check actual evidence package labels in evidence tracking software {OTHER}
inputs: actual inspected evidence and chosen packaging
actual existing case/item identifier records
outputs: checked actual package labels and item references

steps.what: Package collected pieces of evidence in securely closed bags, crates or boxes and inspect seals
inputs: actual inspected evidence and chosen packaging
checked actual package labels and item references
outputs: actual securely closed, labelled evidence packages and observed seal state

steps.what: Record and check actual packaging, item identity, seal state and custody details
inputs: actual securely closed, labelled evidence packages and observed seal state
actual custodian and packaging time/location
outputs: checked final actual evidence packaging/custody entry

steps.what: Commit the checked actual evidence packaging and custody entry
inputs: checked final actual evidence packaging/custody entry

tasks.design: Configure native existing case/item label fields in evidence tracking software {OTHER}. The investigator verifies actual item identity, retains protective packaging and seal inspection, captures actual custody facts and checks the entry before a separate commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence packaging may repeat existing case/item identifiers on labels.
tasks.enabler_now: Native label fields can reuse verified existing references.
tasks.still_hard: Preservation, separation and secure closure require physical evidence handling.
tasks.human_edge: The investigator identifies contamination or packaging risks specific to the actual item.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated label entry; secure packaging stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native evidence labels can reuse existing case/item identifiers; they do not protect, seal or establish custody of physical evidence.

assumptions: Actual collector/case owner supplies existing case/item identity, checked against physical evidence in s1/s2. New item descriptions and label accuracy stay in retained s2; missing identity remains manual.

Only repeated label identifiers lose time. Physical protection, bagging/boxing, seal checks and actual custody capture/check remain fully retained. Custody outcome is recorded after actual packaging, not predicted from a label.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native labels first; existing prefilled labels earn zero saving. Actual label/custody requirements only; absent branches removed and actual physical work reweighted.

Commit retains one percent using existing final check. Any actual custody transfer is a separate actual handoff with its own final checked details and acceptance; no transfer labour saving assumed here.
unknowns: Are existing case/item identifiers retyped on labels?
research_questions: Can native labels reduce duplicate identifiers after full physical-item checks?

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final actual packaging/custody entry and exact case/item destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.20 repeated label identifiers = 4; minus 0.5 upkeep = 3.5. Half eligible gives 2 minus 0.5 = 1.5. Physical packaging, actual custody capture/check and commit retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Analyze evidence to determine probable fire or explosion cause.

steps.what: Retrieve and verify actual evidence references, scene records and other investigation information
inputs: actual case scope and collected evidence references
actual scene observations, test reports and witness records

steps.what: Analyze evidence and other information to determine probable cause of fire or explosion
inputs: checked actual cause-analysis evidence set
actual competing cause hypotheses and source limitations
outputs: actual probable-cause assessment, alternatives and uncertainty

steps.what: Record and check actual cause reasoning, evidence references and unresolved alternatives
inputs: actual probable-cause assessment, alternatives and uncertainty
checked actual cause-analysis evidence set

steps.what: Save the checked actual cause-analysis record
inputs: checked final actual cause-analysis record

tasks.design: Configure native case/evidence/source links in investigation software {OTHER} and {DOCS}. The investigator checks actual originals, retains all cause analysis and captures/checks the actual reasoning before a separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Cause analysis can repeat navigation between evidence and scene/test records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case/source links can reduce retrieval.
tasks.still_hard: Probable cause requires weighing evidence and competing explanations.
tasks.human_edge: The investigator recognises when the evidence supports uncertainty rather than a confident cause.
tasks.altitude: Less evidence navigation; cause reasoning remains human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native case/source links can support evidence retrieval; they do not determine probable fire or explosion cause.

assumptions: Actual evidence/test/scene owners supply source records and references; investigator verifies identity and relevance in s1. Missing evidence cannot be reconstructed from fluent summaries.
Only navigation loses time; original evidence review, actual cause reasoning, uncertainty, record capture and full check remain retained. No automated arson determination or person allegation.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native links first; existing access earns zero saving. Routine save retains one percent using existing final check. Shared reasoning/report production under 22991 is counted once; no separate external send assumed here.
research_questions: Can native links shorten retrieval while preserving complete cause analysis?

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final actual cause-analysis record and exact case destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.40 evidence navigation = 8; minus 0.5 upkeep = 7.5. Half eligible gives 4 minus 0.5 = 3.5. Cause analysis, actual reasoning capture/check and save retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Fire investigators retain evidence judgement and testimony while actual duplicate records and report drafting may shrink.
role.ambitious_version: Measure actual duplicate entry and report writing without inferring cause, custody or person status.
